## Coverage fallback: in season, fewer than 3 wholly-open gaps

The champion ranks these on the stage rate (50/50 or new), which includes closed months. Candidates that can form a rate are compared to that stage rate on the rows where they can.

| Candidate | Rows with a rate | Stage-rate WAPE | Candidate WAPE | Δ | 95% interval | Bias: stage → cand |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| none | 0 | – | – | – | – | every in-season ranked closer row had ≥ 3 wholly-open gaps |

## False urgency proxy (weekly snapshots, detected closers, 2018-19 and 2021-26)

Flagged = projected gallons at least the customer's median pickup over its last 6 (capacity history does not exist). A flagged week with no pickup in the next 30 days is *possible* false urgency: the truck may simply not have come. G0-G5 differ only in season; off-season rows are the champion's own.

| Snapshot set | Model | Customer-weeks ranked | Flagged (proj ≥ median pickup) | of which no pickup within 30 d | Pickup within 30 d but NOT flagged |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| off-season, ranked (semi/detected closer called recently) | G0 | 444 | 214 | 188 (88%) | 23 |
| in season | G0 | 1,817 | 458 | 172 (38%) | 876 |
| in season | G2 | 1,817 | 257 | 95 (37%) | 1,000 |
| in season | G3 | 1,817 | 340 | 93 (27%) | 915 |
| in season | G4 | 1,817 | 492 | 180 (37%) | 850 |
| in season | G5 | 1,817 | 481 | 179 (37%) | 860 |
